title: Front Office Standard: Check-In and Check-Out on Room Reservations
content:
Check-in and check-out on a Room Reservations reservation are recorded by the hotel's front desk. Guest services cannot check a guest in or out.

## Check-in

Check-in is recorded only on or after the reservation's arrival date. The check-in date is compared with the arrival date as calendar dates in hotel local time, with an offset of 0 days: check-in on the arrival date itself is allowed.

| Arrival date (hypothetical) | Check-in date | Allowed? |
|---|---|---|
| 12 April | 11 April | No — before the arrival date |
| 12 April | 12 April | Yes — the arrival date itself |
| 12 April | 13 April | Yes — after the arrival date |

At check-in the folio of the stay is opened under the hotel's brand, any money held for the reservation is transferred to it as a payment, and Free Night Awards applied to the reservation are redeemed.

## Check-out

Check-out may happen on the scheduled departure date or earlier; a check-out before the departure date is an early departure, and the nights stayed are the nights between the actual check-in and actual check-out dates.

At check-out, when the reservation carries an Ashbury Rewards membership:

- elite night credits are posted for the nights stayed when the plan counts toward elite nights;
- points are posted when the plan earns base points, with the elite bonus when the plan earns the elite bonus.

## Channel conditions on earning and benefits

- A reservation booked through an online travel agency earns nothing unless the plan earns on online travel agency bookings.
- A reservation booked by a travel agency through a global distribution system earns only when the plan earns on such bookings.
- Elite on-property benefits are not honoured on online travel agency reservations unless the plan honours them on such bookings.

**Hypothetical early departure.** A guest checked in on 12 April for a stay due to depart on 16 April and checked out on 14 April; the nights stayed are 2, the nights between 12 and 14 April.
